modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Whatever fare you choose, one piece of cabin baggage is included.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: One bag per person, up to 55 cm X 35 cm X 25 cm including pockets, wheels and handles.

carryon_weight.value: Up to 10kg; on flights operated by Beech 1900, cabin baggage is limited to 6 kg.

personal_item.value: A handbag or computer bag up to 30 cm X 40 cm X 15 cm and 2kg.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: How many bags travel free in the hold depends on your ticket type, shown at booking and on your ticket.

first_bag_fee.value: If your fare has no checked bag, one can be added up to 3 hours before departure for €30, or for €40 at the airport. A second bag of 23 kg costs €50 booked in advance or €60 at the airport.

overweight_oversize.value: Bags over 23 kg (maximum 32 kg): €70 supplement. Bags between 159 cm and 300 cm in length + width + height: €40 supplement, with no single length over 160cm. Both are paid at the airport.

online_checkin.value: Online check-in opens 48 hours before departure.
